_about: One brand file for both plugins, deck-graphics and deck-builder. Put it at your repo root as brand.json; both plugins find it by walking up from the deck. Every value here is a neutral placeholder: replace it with your own design system. Nothing in this template is anyone's real brand.
name: Your Company
design_system: Optional. A path or URL to your design system, such as a Claude Design handoff folder. The plugins don't parse it; the skill and people read it for guidance.

fonts._about: family is what the HTML decks use. slides_equivalent is the Google Slides font the editable PPTX uses in its place; keep them the same when your font is already in Google Slides.

effects._about: display_text_shadow is a CSS text-shadow for display type, e.g. a glow. null means none. An editable PPTX cannot reproduce it; the fidelity step asks per slide.

graphics._about: Read by deck-graphics. A style is a prompt preamble plus reference images (paths relative to this file) the image model is asked to match.

flat.preamble: Flat, minimal illustration on a dark background, one accent color, no gradients, no text, no watermark.

decks._about: Read by deck-builder. The defaults live in the plugin and are all listed by its `defaults` command. Anything set here overrides them for every deck in the repo; a deck's own deck.json can override again.
